LINK::lasthop
Description
Returns the MAC address of the last hop.
Syntax
LINK
::
lasthop
[
id
|
name
|
type
]
LINK::lasthop
Returns the MAC address of the last hop
LINK::lasthop id
Returns the MAC address of the last hop
LINK::lasthop name
Returns the name of the last hop
LINK::lasthop type
Returns the type of the last hop, namely “VLAN”, “VLAN-GROUP”, “TUNNEL”, “LOOPBACK”, or “UKNOWN”
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
lastmac
[
LINK
::
lasthop
]
session
add
uie
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
$lastmac
180
}
